simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תְּשׁוּקָה (H8669) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תְּשׁוּקָה (tᵉshûwqâh) means a longing First listed occurrence: Gen 3 16.

definitions.full: H8669. teshuqah [ תְּשׁוּקָה ] noun feminine longing ; — of woman for man, תְּשׁוּקָתֵח אֶלאִֿישֵׁח Gen 3:16 (J); of man for woman, תְּשׁוּקָתוֺ וְאֵלַי לְדוֺדִי אֲנִי Cant 7:11; of beast to devour, figurative תְּשׁוּקָתוֺ אֵלֶיךָ 4:7 (J). ( ᵐ5 ἀποστροφή Genesis, ἐπιστροφή Canticles, whence Nes Marg. 6 proposes תְּשׁוּבָתֵךְ 3:16 , which Ball Hpt reads in all; but how explain the unusual and striking word in MT?).
definitions.rootNote: from 7783 in the original sense of stretching out after;
